title: Paperclip-ing heartbeat contract (fleet producer -> upstream surface)
description: The frozen heartbeat seam between the fleet's rung beats (fleet/monitor.py, fleet/brain.py) and the upstream operator surface (issue #370, ADR-0013). A heartbeat is either an event wake (assigned / commented / unblocked / review-requested) or a scheduled tick; it carries the delta so the consumer does not re-read history, and it ends in durable progress or a named blocker with an owner. See docs/PAPERCLIP-ING-INTEGRATION.md.

agent_id.description: Agent identity that emitted the beat (fleet: the rung/agent id; upstream: the agent record id).

session_id.description: The minted session identity bound to the one issue this agent is working (fleet: AO_SESSION_ID).

tick.description: Monotonic tick counter for this agent's run; a scheduled tick advances it, an event wake does not reset it.

cadence_seconds.description: The scheduled cadence between ticks (fleet: fleet/monitor.py POLL_SECONDS; the staleness ceiling is fleet/channel.py STALE_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS).

wake.description: Why this beat fired, and the delta it carries so the consumer needs no history re-read.

cause.description: Event wake (assigned / commented / unblocked / review-requested) or scheduled tick.

delta.description: The change since the previous beat (the upstream wake carries this so the agent does not re-read history).

outcome.description: What the beat ends in: durable progress, or a named blocker with an owner.

status.description: progress = durable forward motion; blocked = a named blocker with an owner.

detail.description: Human-readable summary of the progress made or the blocker named.

owner.description: The single accountable owner for the next step — the blocker's owner when status is blocked.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the beat (fleet beats carry the same field).
